Aon exists to shape decisions for the better-to protect the lives of people around the world. With actionable analytic insights, risk and human capital expertise, the company serves clients in 120 countries. Aon took steps to substantially improve enterprise tooling with the capability to automate broking and claims processing. Aon wanted to eliminate the need to manually triage thousands of spam communications. Wishing to improve its ability to process complex communications, Aon required a unified case-processing tool to assign work to team members, monitor analytics, and implement a sound data governance strategy.
